BiblicalUsage: Zoan is a city in Egypt, named in the field where God did His wonders for Israel. In Numbers 13:22, Now Hebron was built seven years before Zoan in Egypt. The place has its own entry in Biblical Places.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Zoan matters because God's wonders in Egypt happened in a real city with real princes, not in a storybook.
